inputs: step selector for the earlier step
step selector for the later step
proves: The submitted structured output represents the earlier step before the later step.
cannotProve: That any event occurred in that order in the real world.
That the author intended the declared order.
That execution would follow the declared order.

inputs: two event references carrying independently produced event times
an approved and pinned event-source configuration
proves: Ordering within an approved evidence model, once and only once the event source and its configuration have been externally approved and pinned.
cannotProve: That the timestamp was honestly generated.
That no relevant event was omitted.
